description.zh: 记下一次推导、仿真或实验：研究问题、环境、随机种子、参数与指标（带单位）、结论和结果材料。列表按做法筛选，也能搜索、归档与移入回收站；详情直接编辑并在输入时自动存草稿，保存失败保留输入，修订冲突可以载入最新记录。缺失的内容显示「未知」，这里只记录不执行实验程序。
description.en: Records a derivation, simulation or experiment: research question, environment, seeds, parameters and metrics with units, conclusion and result materials. The list filters by method, also searches, archives and trashes; the detail edits in place, keeps a draft while you type, keeps your input when saving fails, and offers the latest record on a revision conflict. Missing content shows as unknown, and nothing is executed here.

search.zh: 搜索标题、问题、环境与结论
search.en: Search titles, questions, environments and conclusions

emptyActive.zh: 还没有研究记录；点「新建」记下一次推导、仿真或实验。
emptyActive.en: No research notes yet; use New to record a derivation, simulation or experiment.

emptyTrash.zh: 回收站是空的。移入回收站的记录三十天后自动清除。
emptyTrash.en: The trash is empty. Trashed records are cleared after thirty days.

truncated.zh: 只列出最近 {n} 条，共 {total} 条；用搜索找更早的记录。
truncated.en: Showing the latest {n} of {total}; search for older records.

quotaWarning.zh: 记录已用到 {percent}%，先整理归档或回收站。
quotaWarning.en: Records use {percent}% of the limit; tidy the archive or trash.

materialInvalid.zh: 材料地址只收 http/https 的完整地址，说明不能为空。
materialInvalid.en: Material links must be complete http/https addresses with a title.

environmentHint.zh: 例如机器、工具链版本与依赖；留空时列表显示未知。
environmentHint.en: For example machine, toolchain versions and dependencies; an empty field shows as unknown.

seedHint.zh: 一组或多组种子，原样记录；留空时列表显示未知。
seedHint.en: One or more seeds, recorded as written; an empty field shows as unknown.

entryInvalid.zh: 参数与指标要同时有名称和数值；整行留空会丢掉。
entryInvalid.en: Parameters and metrics need both a name and a value; entirely empty rows are dropped.

conclusionHint.zh: 结论与材料只是记录，不执行实验程序。
conclusionHint.en: Conclusions and materials are recorded only; nothing is executed.

draftRestored.zh: 已恢复上次未保存的内容。

unsavedClose.zh: 还有没保存的修改；关闭后草稿会保留。
unsavedClose.en: There are unsaved changes; closing keeps the draft.

conflict.zh: 这条记录在别处更新过，保存被拒绝。可以载入最新的内容，或继续用你的编辑。
conflict.en: This record changed elsewhere and the save was rejected. Load the latest content, or continue with your edits.

loadLatest.zh: 载入最新（放弃本地修改）

trashRestoreHint.zh: 回收站里的记录三十天后自动清除；先恢复再编辑。
trashRestoreHint.en: Trashed records are cleared after thirty days; restore before editing.
